gitCommit.subject: feat(canvas): frame story improvements (#1371)
gitCommit.body:
feat(canvas): frame story improvements (#1371)

* feat(canvas): implement frame improvements — visual polish, scaling behavior, and export presets

Implement 7 user stories across 3 epics for the Frame feature:

Epic 1 — Frame Visual Polish:
- S1: Corner-only resize anchors with styled handles
- S2: Configurable label gap via FRAME_LABEL_GAP constant
- S3: Extract frame constants to constants/frame.ts

Epic 2 — Frame Scaling Behavior:
- S4: Shift-key aspect ratio lock during resize
- S5: Per-frame stroke color/width overrides with strokeScaleEnabled

Epic 3 — Frame Export:
- S6: Export presets panel with platform presets (Instagram, Twitter/X, TikTok, YouTube)
     and target dimension letterbox/fit scaling in frame-export utility
- S7: Custom dimension export with aspect lock, scale factor (1x/2x/3x), and input validation

Adds 53 new tests (968 total passing). Built with TDD (Red → Green) and
Tidy First ordering (structural changes before behavioral).

* feat(canvas): improve frame export UX — unified download, visual aspect ratio picker, and panel enhancements

Consolidate two download buttons into a single button that opens the export panel
with quick PNG/JPG download at the top. Add visual aspect ratio picker with
proportional shape previews and platform hints (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok).
Add 4:5 ratio for Instagram Portrait. Show computed pixel dimensions on scale
factor radio buttons. Default aspect lock to ON. Make export panel scrollable
for small viewports.

* fix(canvas): round frame dimensions in export panel

Konva frame width/height are floating-point values that were passed
directly to FrameExportPanel, causing long decimal strings in the UI.

* feat(canvas): refine frame toolbar — thinner border, sharp corners, reorder actions

Reduce frame border width (8→2px) and remove rounded corners (radius 24→0)
for print-ready output. Reorder toolbar to: aspect ratio, download, publish, delete.

* feat(canvas): add aspect ratio lock indicators — badge icon and hollow/solid handles

Show visual feedback when a frame's aspect ratio is locked:
- Lock badge on the aspect ratio toolbar button (emerald, top-right corner)
- Toast notification on lock/unlock with translated ratio name
- Hollow resize handles for free resize, solid handles for locked resize
- Force Transformer remount on ratio change to refresh anchor styles

i18n: add aspectRatioLocked/aspectRatioUnlocked keys to all 4 locales

* fix(canvas): fill frame resize handles with white instead of transparent

Prevents the frame border line from showing through the hollow anchor
squares when aspect ratio is unlocked.

* style(canvas): use Excalidraw purple for frame resize handles

Switch frame selection and anchor fill color from blue-500 (#2563eb)
to Excalidraw's selection purple (#6965db) for a more distinctive look.

* fix(canvas): use proxy rect for frame Transformer to fix handle positioning

Transformer handles were mispositioned when children overflowed the frame
clip boundary because getClientRect() included overflowing content. A proxy
Rect with exact frame dimensions now serves as the Transformer target,
with batched setAttrs() for efficient live mirroring during resize.

* fix(canvas): prevent frame resize from scaling children

Stop applying scaleX/scaleY to the frame Group during resize. Instead,
directly update clip rect, border rect, and background rect dimensions
so children maintain their original size and position during drag.

- Extract computeFrameDims() helper to bake proxy scale into dimensions
- Add backgroundRef for imperative updates during transform
- Extract syncFrameVisuals() to reduce duplication between handlers
- Reset all element states in onTransformEnd for clean React re-render
- Add unit tests for dimension computation and child position behavior

* fix(canvas): keep frame children stationary during top/left resize

Previously, resizing a frame from the top or left border moved both the
Group position and children positions, causing content to drift with the
border. Now the Group stays stationary and only visual elements (clip,
border, background) are offset by the position delta during live resize.
Children maintain their absolute screen positions throughout.

* test(canvas): add regression tests for frame content positioning bugs

Add comprehensive test suite covering two critical frame resize bugs:
1. Content position shifting when frame resized from top/left
2. Child transform preservation (scale/rotation maintained)

Tests verify correct behavior across 7 scenarios:
- Top/left resize shifts children by position delta
- Bottom/right resize maintains child positions (no delta)
- Multiple children handled correctly
- Child transforms preserved after frame operations
- Integration: resize + transform preservation

Implements applyFrameTransformEnd() in object-transforms.ts to fix the
underlying bug by calculating position deltas and shifting frame children
when frame position changes during resize.

Passing: 981 tests, frame-content-bugs: 7/7

* fix(canvas): keep frame children stationary during resize and track toolbar during drag

Two frame-related bugs fixed:

1. Frame resize no longer moves children — removed child-shifting logic
   from applyFrameTransformEnd since children store absolute positions
   and the rendering layer handles offset automatically.

2. Frame child images now update the drag store during drag via new
   onImageDragMove prop, so the floating toolbar tracks in real-time
   instead of jumping on drag end.

* fix(canvas): adjust frame child position when containment changes to prevent position jumping

When a frame child (image, text, shape) is dragged from one frame to another, the
object's position would jump to an incorrect location because position adjustment
was missing during the containment update.

ROOT CAUSE:
Frame children render using frame-local coordinates: renderPos = absolute - framePos.
When updateFrameContainment() moved an object's parentId from frameA to frameB, the
absolute position was not adjusted, causing the rendering layer to apply the wrong
frame offset.

EXAMPLE:
- Child at (150, 150) in frameA(100, 100) renders at (50, 50)
- Moving to frameB(200, 200) would keep position at (150, 150)
- This renders at (-50, -50) instead of the expected (50, 50)
- Fix calculates position delta and adjusts: (150, 150) + (200-100, 200-100) = (250, 250)

FIX:
Calculate positionDelta = targetFrame.pos - currentFrame.pos when parentId changes,
and apply this delta to maintain the visual rendering position.

TEST:
Add comprehensive regression tests in frame-child-containment-position.test.ts to
verify position adjustment works correctly across multiple frame transition scenarios.

* fix(canvas): remove incorrect position delta in frame containment transitions

The position delta in updateFrameContainment double-adjusted positions
during frame-to-frame transitions. All callers already provide canvas-
absolute positions (via offsetChildNodePosition or direct node coords),
so the delta was causing content to jump right when dragged between frames.

Regression tests added for all four containment transition types:
frame-to-root, root-to-frame, frame-to-frame, and same-frame.

* test(canvas): remove obsolete frame test files and fixtures

Cleans up test files that were superseded by focused regression tests
added in recent commits. Removes unused transformer mock fixtures.

* fix(canvas): correct frame child positioning during resize and drag

Use computeFrameDims for visual element reset in onTransformEnd to
prevent React-Konva prop diffing from retaining stale clipX/clipY
offsets. Convert frame-local to canvas-absolute coords in mouseUp
handler for frame children. Account for object scale in containment
center calculation. Remove manual node.position() sync that conflicted
with React-Konva re-rendering after containment changes.

* feat(canvas): change frame resize Shift key from hold-to-lock to toggle

Replace hold-Shift-to-lock aspect ratio with press-Shift-to-toggle for
a smoother one-handed resize experience. Adds e.repeat guard to prevent
rapid toggling on key hold and blur listener to reset state on window
focus loss.

* feat(canvas): auto-group objects when frame is dragged over them

Add auto-group-on-frame-move feature: when a user drags a frame over
ungrouped objects, those objects automatically become children of the
frame at drag-end. Uses center-point containment matching existing
updateFrameContainment behavior, single atomic undo step, and a
minimal border color indicator during drag preview.

- Add object-bounds helpers (getObjectCenter, getObjectBounds)
- Add frame-auto-group utilities (isCenterInsideFrame, findAutoGroupCandidates, applyAutoGroup, autoGroupOnFrameDragEnd, batchUpdateParentage)
- Wire auto-group into handleFrameDragEnd in gazai-canvas
- Add border color indicator during drag-move for visual feedback
- Add 'Auto-Grouped Frame' history action type
- Add 34 unit tests covering containment, guards, mutations, and integration

* feat(canvas): auto-group and ungroup objects on frame resize

Extend auto-grouping to frame resize: objects whose centers fall inside
the new bounds get grouped, and existing children whose centers fall
outside get ungrouped. Add dashed green border visual feedback during
resize transform to indicate candidate captures.

* feat(canvas): auto-group objects when frame is created over them

Add live preview during frame creation that highlights candidates with
green dashed border, then auto-groups contained objects on mouseup.
Skips auto-group when min-size fallback triggers (accidental click).

Includes 16 new tests covering preview, commit, and edge cases.

* fix(canvas): clear leftover dashed border on frame deselection

Auto-group visual feedback sets border dash imperatively, which
React-Konva never resets since dash is not declared as a prop.
Add useEffect cleanup that clears dash when frame becomes unselected.

* fix(canvas): prevent frame children clipped on first drag after resize auto-group

Add synchronous imperative clip management in child drag callbacks.
After resize auto-group, onTransformEnd leaves imperative clip attrs
on the Konva node that React-Konva's prop diffing won't clear. The
fix disables clip with undefined (not 0) in handleChildDragStart and
restores it in createChildDragEnd, alongside the existing async React
state updates.

Also unify auto-group visual feedback to use dashed border style
instead of color change, and pass allCanvasObjects to FrameNode for
resize candidate detection.

* test(canvas): add unit tests for frame story improvements

Cover constants and logic for:
- S1: corner handle appearance (size, color, corner radius)
- S2: frame label gap
- S3: resize handles (corner-only, no edge midpoints, min size)
- S4: Shift+drag aspect lock logic (effectiveKeepRatio, isTextInput)
- S5: stroke override (custom strokeColor/strokeWidth with selection state)
- Frame export presets (6 presets across 4 platforms)
- exportFrameToDataUrl target dimensions (letterbox, centering, bg fill)

* chore: remove completed frame improvements implementation plans

The tidy-first plans have been fully implemented and are no longer needed.

* style(canvas): update frame border colors to Catppuccin Mocha palette

Replace generic grays and blues with Catppuccin Mocha colors:
- FRAME_BORDER_COLOR: #bbb → #b4befe (Lavender, inactive state)
- FRAME_SELECTION_COLOR: #6965db → #cba6f7 (Mauve, selected state)
- FRAME_ANCHOR_FILL: #6965db → #cba6f7 (Mauve, transformer handles)

Also fix pre-existing test asserting FRAME_BORDER_WIDTH as 8 (actual value is 2).

* feat(canvas): add frame border drag-to-resize via side anchors

Users can now drag frame borders to resize: left/right borders adjust
width only, top/bottom borders adjust height only. Side anchors are
hidden when keepRatio is active (corners only in that mode).

Extracts computeBoundBoxForAnchor as a pure utility with 14 unit tests.
Uses Konva Transformer side anchors with smart boundBoxFunc that locks
the perpendicular axis via getActiveAnchor(). enabledAnchors memoized
to avoid unnecessary Transformer anchor churn on each render.

* fix(canvas): narrow Konva type for findOne calls on frame drag handlers

Cast e.target to Konva.Group and use findOne<Konva.Shape> to satisfy
TypeScript — the Group guard already ensures the type at runtime.
